name: read_text_file
description: Returns the full text content of a file as a UTF-8 string.

name: read_media_file
description: Returns a binary file's content as a base64-encoded blob with its MIME type.

name: read_multiple_files
description: Reads several files in one call and returns their contents in a single response.

name: write_file
description: Creates a new file or completely overwrites an existing one with the given content string.

name: edit_file
description: Applies one or more find-and-replace operations to an existing file and returns a git-style diff of the changes.

name: list_directory
description: Lists the immediate contents of a directory. Each entry is prefixed with [FILE] or [DIR].

name: list_directory_with_sizes
description: Lists directory contents and includes file sizes in bytes; supports sorting.

name: directory_tree
description: Returns the full recursive tree of a directory as a JSON structure.

name: search_files
description: Finds files matching a glob pattern within a directory.

name: get_file_info
description: Returns metadata about a file or directory: size, timestamps, type, and permissions.

name: create_directory
description: Creates a directory and any missing parent directories.

name: move_file
description: Moves or renames a file or directory.

name: list_allowed_directories
description: Returns the list of root directories the server was started with.
